rule.name: No Hardcoded Credentials
rule.description: Never commit passwords, tokens, API keys, or secrets in source code
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Hardcoded credential detected. Move to process.env.VARIABLE_NAME.

rule.name: No Direct Grid Control Commands
rule.description: APS grid control operations must never be triggered from the dashboard API
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Grid control is read-only in this dashboard.

rule.name: Mock Data Only
rule.description: This is a demo — never connect to real APS operational systems or SCADA
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Demo must use mock data only. No real APS grid or customer data.

rule.name: No Customer PII
rule.description: Do not include real customer names, addresses, account numbers, or meter IDs
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: No real customer PII allowed. Use anonymized or synthetic data.

rule.name: Routes Must Use Service Layer
rule.description: Route handlers must call the service layer — no inline business logic
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Routes must call apsService — no inline business logic.

rule.name: CLIENT_NAME Must Be Configurable
rule.description: Client display name must always come from process.env.CLIENT_NAME
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Use process.env.CLIENT_NAME — never hard-code the client name.

rule.name: No Direct Commits to Main
rule.description: All changes go through a PR — main branch is protected
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Create a bob/ branch and open a PR. No direct commits to main.

rule.name: CI Must Pass Before Merge
rule.description: All tests and checks must be green before a PR can be merged
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Fix failing CI checks before merging. Run: npm test

rule.name: No Known HIGH or CRITICAL Vulnerabilities in Dependencies
rule.description: npm audit must report zero HIGH or CRITICAL severity CVEs before a PR is merged. Bob checks this rule before proposing any dependency change and will surface any existing vulnerabilities found by: npm audit --audit-level=high
rule.remediation: 1. Run: npm audit --audit-level=high 2. Identify the vulnerable package and the patched version 3. Update the version in package.json 4. Run: npm install and npm test 5. Confirm: npm audit exits 0
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs detected in dependencies. Run `npm audit --audit-level=high` to see affected packages. Fix all HIGH+ vulnerabilities before this PR can merge. Ref: https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v9/commands/npm-audit
